As a

title: Sr. Analyst, Implementation
description:
What You'll Do
  
  
**Role Summary — The Why Now**
As Avalara scales its Go Live function to support New Product Introductions (NPI) and enterprise-level customer growth, we need Senior Analysts who do more than execute — they lead, design, and elevate. The Go Live Senior Analyst (I3) operates at the intersection of complex enterprise implementation delivery, cross-functional product collaboration, and practice development.
  
  
Where the I3 Analyst owns individual customer implementation success, the I3 Senior Analyst owns the quality and scalability of how implementations are delivered — for the most complex customers, across new and evolving products, and in close partnership with Product Management, Sales, Engineering, and Customer Success.
  
  
This role exists to accelerate Avalara's ability to onboard enterprise customers at scale, introduce new products effectively, and continuously raise the implementation standard across the Go Live team. The I3 is a force multiplier: their impact is felt not just in their own portfolio, but in the capability and quality of the broader team.
  
  
How This Role Elevates Avalara
  
  

* For customers: Enterprise and multi-product customers receive expert implementation guidance, proactive risk management, and deep technical partnership — resulting in faster time-to-value and stronger long-term adoption.
* For the team: The Senior Analyst sets the implementation quality standard — authoring playbooks, mentoring I3 analysts, and identifying process improvements that raise team-wide performance.
* For the business: Directly supports ARR growth by enabling complex enterprise wins, supporting the sales cycle with pre-sales expertise, and accelerating NPI readiness across implementation teams.
* For our AI-first strategy: Designs and deploys AI-driven implementation workflows at a team level — moving beyond personal productivity to scalable automation that benefits the entire Go Live function.

**What Your Responsibilities Will Be**
**Enterprise & Multi-Product Implementation Leadership**

* Lead customer implementations involving multiple Avalara products and enterprise-level platforms including complex ERP, POS, and ecommerce environments (e.g., NetSuite, Dynamics 365, Salesforce Commerce, SAP).
* Act as the primary implementation authority for high-complexity, high-stakes customer engagements — setting strategy, managing scope, and driving outcomes from kickoff to Go Live.
* Clearly define, articulate, and manage scope of work for client-initiated implementation and data service projects, including change management when scope evolves.

**New Product Introduction (NPI) Enablement**

* Partner with Avalara Product Management, Sales, and Customer Success teams to develop implementation approach documentation, onboarding frameworks, and training materials for new product launches.
* Serve as a subject matter expert during NPI cycles — identifying implementation risks, documenting configuration requirements, and ensuring Go Live readiness before product release.
* Identify bugs, integration gaps, or UX friction during NPI implementations and partner with Engineering to track and resolve them.

**Practice Development & Quality Elevation**

* Own and evolve Go Live practice standards — documenting business processes, designing implementation playbooks, and proposing best practices for sales and use tax automation onboarding.
* Develop and document business requirements related to implementation workflows, data transformation, and cross-system reporting.
* Lead testing plan design and execution for complex implementations, ensuring customers go live on validated, stable configurations.
* Mentor and provide structured guidance to I2 Analysts — reviewing implementation quality, sharing expertise, and accelerating the development of junior team members.

**Cross-Functional Stakeholder Partnership**

* Collaborate with Sales and Account Management to support pre-sales activities — including scoping, solution design input, and customer-facing technical presentations.
* Engage cross-functionally across Product, Engineering, Support, and Finance to resolve systemic implementation blockers and drive process improvements at scale.
* Represent the Go Live team's perspective in strategic planning discussions, NPI readiness reviews, and cross-departmental initiatives.

**Customer Success & Risk Management**

* Monitor project health across assigned accounts — proactively identifying risk factors, intervening early, and resolving escalations with speed and precision.
* Provide strategic guidance to customers on best practices and use cases across a range of business models and tax compliance needs.
* Support customers in developing and executing testing plans, ensuring technical readiness before Go Live.

**AI-Driven Practice Scaling**

* Design and deploy AI-powered workflows at a team level — building reusable Glean AI agents, prompt libraries, and automation tools that improve implementation quality and speed across the Go Live function.
* Share AI innovations, document their impact, and drive adoption across I2 and I3 peers.

**12-Month Success Signals**
A successful Go Live Senior Analyst (I3) at the end of 12 months will have:
  
  

* Led multiple enterprise or multi-product implementations to successful Go Live with measurably shorter cycle times and low escalation rates, demonstrating ownership at a higher complexity tier than I2.
* Delivered at least two NPI readiness contributions — documented implementation playbooks, training materials, or bug reports — that were formally adopted by the Go Live or Product teams.
* Authored or significantly improved at least two Go Live practice standards or playbooks, with measurable adoption and quality impact across the team.
* Mentored at least two I2 Analysts with demonstrable improvement in their implementation quality metrics or time-to-competency.
* Built and deployed at least one AI-powered workflow (e.g., a Glean agent, automation script, or prompt framework) that generated measurable time savings or quality improvements at a team level — not just personally.
* Supported at least one pre-sales engagement in partnership with the Sales or Account Management team, contributing to a customer expansion or new business outcome.

AI Expectations
  
  
Avalara is an AI-first company. The Go Live Senior Analyst (I3) is expected to operate as an AI Bar Raiser — not just embedding AI into their own work, but actively raising AI capability across the Go Live team.
  
  
**Specific Expectations Include**

* Design and build reusable AI tools — including Glean AI agents, automated documentation workflows, and AI-assisted risk detection models — that are shared and adopted across the team.
* Use AI to analyze implementation portfolio data at scale, identifying patterns in at-risk implementations, NPI friction points, or recurring ERP configuration issues, and translating insights into proactive action.
* Deploy AI to accelerate NPI documentation, training material generation, and business requirements capture — dramatically compressing the time from product release to team readiness.
* Use AI to support customer communication at scale — generating implementation status summaries, tailored onboarding guidance, and escalation documentation with speed and precision.
* Coach I2 Analysts on applied AI usage, sharing effective practices and helping peers move from casual familiarity to embedded, outcome-driven AI workflows.
* Apply AI responsibly and securely, in full compliance with Avalara's data governance and AI ethics policies.

Candidates must demonstrate specific, quantified examples of AI usage that improved team-level outcomes — not just personal efficiency. Senior Analysts who cannot clearly articulate their AI impact across a team or function do not meet Avalara's AI Bar Raiser standard for this level.
  
  
What You’ll Need To Be Successful
  
  
**Required**
Bachelor’s in computer science, Engineering, or equivalent technical discipline (BCA, MCA, B.Tech from an accredited institution). Open to hire from Commerce background given strong technical acumen or expertise of implementation.
  
  

* 4–7 years of software implementation or delivery experience, preferably within the B2B SaaS sector, with demonstrated progression in scope and complexity.
* Proven ability to lead complex, enterprise-level software implementations across multiple products and ERP/ecommerce environments.
* Strong ability to articulate process logic and technical architecture — including design and delivery of functional and technical presentations to customers and internal stakeholders.
* Strong understanding of accounting and tax processes, including sales and use tax compliance automation concepts.
* Excellent written and verbal English communication skills, with a demonstrated ability to lead cross-functional conversations and drive alignment.
* Experience contributing to practice improvement — documenting business processes, designing best practices, or owning team-level standards.
* Demonstrated ownership mindset — takes initiative at a team level, holds peers accountable with coaching (not criticism), and drives outcomes without requiring direction.
* Embodies Avalara's Success Traits: Ownership, Simplicity, Curiosity, Adaptability, Urgency, Optimism, and Humility.

**Preferred**

* Hands-on experience configuring or integrating enterprise ERPs such as NetSuite, Dynamics 365, SAP, Salesforce Commerce, Sage, or WooCommerce.
* Proficiency with Salesforce, Gong, Gainsight, Jira, or equivalent CRM and project tracking platforms.
* Prior exposure to tax automation software implementation or tax-related roles.
* Experience in NPI or product launch support — working alongside Product Management or Engineering to prepare implementation teams for new releases.
* Familiarity with APIs, webhooks, and integration architecture concepts.
* Demonstrated experience mentoring or developing junior team members.

**Bar Raiser Expectation**
At Avalara, We Hire Only Those Who Raise The Bar — Not Those Who Merely Meet It. A Go Live Senior Analyst (I3) Who Is a Bar Raiser
  
  

* Improves the average performance of the team simply by being present — through coaching, example, and a consistent commitment to quality.
* Brings data, structure, and strategic thinking to conversations about risk, prioritization, process design, and escalation.
* Challenges assumptions respectfully and proposes better approaches — even when it's uncomfortable.
* Leaves every customer engagement, process, team interaction, and system in a measurably stronger state than they found it.
* Continuously develops technical, functional, and AI capabilities — and actively helps peers do the same.
* Demonstrates strong judgment in tradeoff decisions, especially when they affect customers, timelines, or team capacity.

Being a Bar Raiser at the I3 level means raising the entire team's execution quality — not just excelling individually.
  
  
Avalara is an AI-first Company
  
  
AI is embedded in our workflows, decision-making, and products. Success here requires embracing AI as an essential capability.
  
  

* You’ll bring experience using AI and AI-related technologies, ready to thrive here.
* You’ll apply AI every day to business challenges - improving efficiency, contributing solutions, and driving results for your team, our company, and our customers.
* You’ll grow with AI by staying curious about new trends and best practices, and by sharing what you learn so others can benefit too.

How We’ll Take Care Of You
  
  
Total Rewards
  
  
In addition to a great compensation package, paid time off, and paid parental leave, many Avalara employees are eligible for bonuses.
  
  
Health & Wellness
  
  
Benefits vary by location but generally include private medical, life, and disability insurance.
  
  
Inclusive culture and diversity
  
  
Avalara strongly supports diversity, equity, and inclusion, and is committed to integrating them into our business practices and our organizational culture. We also have a total of 8 employee-run resource groups, each with senior leadership and exec sponsorship.
  
  
**What You Need To Know About Avalara**
We’re defining the relationship between tax and tech.
  
  
We’ve already built an industry-leading cloud compliance platform, processing over 54 billion customer API calls and over 6.6 million tax returns a year. Our growth is real - we're a billion dollar business - and we’re not slowing down until we’ve achieved our mission - to be part of every transaction in the world.
  
  
We’re bright, innovative, and disruptive, like the orange we love to wear. It captures our quirky spirit and optimistic mindset. It shows off the culture we’ve designed, that empowers our people to win. We’ve been different from day one. Join us, and your career will be too.
  
  
**We’re An Equal Opportunity Employer**
Supporting diversity and inclusion is a cornerstone of our company — we don’t want people to fit into our culture, but to enrich it. All qualified candidates will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, creed, religion, age, gender, national orientation, disability, sexual orientation, US Veteran status, or any other factor protected by law. If you require any reasonable adjustments during the recruitment process, please let us know.

title: Principal Backend Engineer
description:
Blitzy is a Cambridge, MA based AI software development platform on a mission to revolutionize the software development life cycle by autonomously building custom software to unlock the next industrial revolution. We're transforming how enterprises build software, turning enterprise requirements into enterprise grade code with an agentic software development platform that can autonomously execute 80% of the quantum of software development work. We're backed by multiple tier 1 investors, and have proven success as founders of previous start-ups.
  
  
**Our Culture**
**Who We Are**
Led by two pioneering co-founders we are one of the fastest growing companies in the U.S., creating our own category of enterprise autonomous software development. We automate thousands of hours of software development for our customers, which includes strong representation within the Fortune 500.
  
  
**How We Work**

* We move Blitzy Fast: Time is both our company’s and our clients’ most precious asset. We move quickly and decisively to innovate internally and deliver exceptional software externally.
* Championship Mindset: We operate like a professional sports team. We win as a team by holding ourselves and each other to high standards, collaborating in-person, and remaining focused on the mission.
* Passion for Invention: We’re pushing the frontier of what’s possible, requiring constant innovation and iteration.
* We Work for the Customer: We focus on delivering outsized value to the customers we work with and expanding those relationships into deep, meaningful partnerships.

**About The Role**
We are hiring a Principal Engineer to take full, hands-on ownership of Blitzy's most critical production-grade systems and to deliver high-leverage features that materially improve customer outcomes and engineering velocity.
  
  
This is the most senior individual contributor role at the company today.
  
  
This is not a Senior-plus role, an architecture-only role, or a promotion-track role. We are looking for someone who has already operated at Principal / Staff+ scope in a highly technical environment and expects to spend their time writing, reviewing, and shipping production code.
  
  
This role is 100% hands-on. Leverage comes from system ownership, execution quality, and durable technical decisions - not people management or process.
  
  
**Responsibilities**

* Own mission-critical production systems end-to-end, ensuring correctness, scalability, performance, reliability, and operational excellence.
* Design, build, and ship high-impact backend systems and features that improve product reliability, performance, and customer value.
* Architect scalable services and cloud infrastructure using technologies such as Python, REST, gRPC, Kubernetes, and Terraform.
* Identify and resolve complex technical bottlenecks that limit engineering quality, system performance, or organizational velocity.
* Build and operate LLM-powered systems and validation loops that evaluate correctness, consistency, durability, and production performance.
* Design and evolve data architectures incorporating relational, NoSQL, graph, and vector databases to support complex enterprise applications and semantic retrieval.
* Modernize and improve complex enterprise systems while balancing reliability, maintainability, scalability, and delivery speed.
* Set and uphold engineering quality standards through hands-on technical leadership, sound technical judgment, and ownership of long-term technical decisions.

**Qualifications**

* 12+ years of direct experience with Python as a primary language, including backend frameworks and microservices architecture at scale
* Expertise in API architectures including REST and gRPC; working proficiency in Node.js and JavaScript
* Advanced proficiency with cloud infrastructure: GCP required, with experience in at least one additional platform (AWS or Azure)
* Advanced, production-grade experience with Kubernetes and Terraform
* Proven experience operating highly available production systems, including monitoring, scalability, reliability, performance optimization, and operational tooling
* Strong knowledge of relational and NoSQL databases, including PostgreSQL, MySQL, MongoDB, Cassandra, or DynamoDB
* Familiarity with graph databases (e.g., Neo4j) and vector databases/embedding infrastructure for semantic search and retrieval
* Hands-on experience building and operating LLM-powered systems in production, including evaluation, validation, regression testing, tracing, and failure analysis
* Working knowledge of LangSmith or comparable LLM observability/evaluation tooling; familiarity with model providers such as OpenAI or Anthropic is a plus
* Full-stack capability, including strong frontend architecture fundamentals and the ability to design, debug, and ship across frontend, backend, infrastructure, and AI systems
* Deep understanding of large-scale enterprise software systems: architecture, integration, deployment, modernization, and long-term maintainability
* Proven track record operating at Staff+/Principal scope, independently driving complex technical initiatives and delivering high-impact outcomes with minimal supervision

*Blitzy is an equal opportunity employer committed to building a diverse and inclusive team. We believe different perspectives make us stronger. * 8+ years of hands-on SaaS engineering experience in cloud environments.

description:
**Job description:**

Deore Designs is an architectural and interior design studio delivering turnkey projects, from concept to execution, for homes and offices. Were looking for an Architect who can take a residential project from concept design through working drawings to rendered 3D views on their own.

  

**Role & responsibilities**

* Develop concept designs, site planning and floor plans for residential buildings (bungalows, row houses and apartment buildings)
* Prepare complete working drawings in AutoCAD: plans, elevations, sections, staircase, door/window schedules and construction details
* Prepare municipal submission drawings in line with UDCPR and local authority (PMC/PMRDA) norms
* Build accurate 3D models in SketchUp and produce photorealistic renders and walkthroughs in Lumion or V-Ray
* Coordinate with structural, MEP and interior teams to integrate designs
* Develop space planning and furniture layouts for residential and commercial (office) interiors
* Prepare detailed 2D drawings in AutoCAD: layouts, elevations, ceiling, electrical, flooring and joinery/furniture details
* Build accurate 3D models in SketchUp from the approved 2D drawings
* Produce high-quality photorealistic renders and walkthroughs in D5 Render
* Coordinate with site teams and contractors during execution, and resolve design queries

  

**Preferred candidate profile**

* B.Arch with 4 to 5 years of experience in residential architecture and interiors
* Strong command of AutoCAD, SketchUp and Lumion/V-Ray (essential)
* Ability to independently prepare working drawings and rendered 3D views
* A portfolio showing completed residential projects, including drawings and renders
* Working knowledge of UDCPR, building bye-laws and construction practices
* Ability to work independently and meet project timelines
* Clear communication with clients, consultants and contractors

  

**Perks and benefits**

* Flexible timing
* Work from home and remote work option available
